description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' Protocol Buffers (protobuf) serialization support, including tests for serialization, deep copying, codecs, and collection handling related to protobuf classes and collections.

classes.name: ProtobufSerializerTests
classes.description: Unit tests for Orleans protobuf serialization, testing serialization, deserialization, pipelining, and deep copying of protobuf classes.

classes.name: ProtobufCodecCopierTests
classes.description: Tests for deep copying protobuf classes using codec-based copiers.

classes.name: ProtobufRepeatedFieldCodecTests
classes.description: Tests for encoding and decoding of RepeatedField collections.

classes.name: ProtobufRepeatedFieldCopierTests
classes.description: Tests for deep copying of RepeatedField collections.

classes.name: MapFieldCodecTests
classes.description: Tests for encoding and decoding of MapField collections.

classes.name: MapFieldCopierTests
classes.description: Tests for deep copying of MapField collections.

classes.name: ByteStringCodecTests
classes.description: Tests for encoding and decoding ByteString objects.

classes.name: ByteStringCopierTests
classes.description: Tests for deep copying ByteString objects.

classes.name: ProtobufGuidExtensions
classes.description: Extension method for converting Guid to ByteString.

methods.description: Configures the serializers in the test for protobuf serialization.

methods.description: Tests deep copying a protobuf object via an untyped deep copier.

methods.name: ProtobufSerializerRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Tests the round-trip serialization/deserialization through the codec.
